minutes.headline: Board approved the new Fitchburg sewer agreement and recommended the school project article
minutes.summary: The board approved the sewer intermunicipal agreement with Fitchburg after a Sewer Commission presentation. It heard the building reuse committee's plan for surplus buildings and a Town Hall renovation. It reviewed the special town meeting warrant and ballot wording, recommended Article 1 for the middle/high school, and leaned toward 30-year financing. A bond rating upgrade was announced.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved the intermunicipal agreement with the City of Fitchburg for sewer service after a Sewer Commission presentation.
The board voted to recommend Article 1, the middle/high school project, at the special town meeting.
Members reached consensus to plan the school borrowing on a 30-year term and stop discussing 20 years.
The ballot question's dollar amount is to be checked with MSBA and bond counsel and revisited next week.
The building reuse committee will stay in place until the special town meeting, with valuation work deferred until after the vote.

why_it_matters: The sewer agreement sets what Lunenburg sewer users pay Fitchburg, including a share of the John Fitch Highway line upgrade starting in FY15.

The school borrowing term and the Article 1 vote shape how much the project adds to a typical tax bill each year and for how many years, and residents will be asked to vote on it at the special town meeting.
watch_next: The board's revisit of the ballot question wording and dollar amount, expected next week.
The special town meeting vote on Article 1, the school project.
